author: LadyLush
quote: I am so disappointed in this game.  It doesn’t feel like GTA at all and is a very heavily guard railed sandbox.  This game completely abandons decades of franchise established crime mayhem for a relationship simulator that pushes you to obey traffic laws, avoid anything criminal, and feels like the sims.  It feels like the game was made by people who hate GTA or have never played it and clutched their pearls when they heard it described. I’m a progressive, a woman, and a lesbian.  I’m a **** alarm clock I’m so woke.  And I **** hate this agenda pushing **** game.
